title: Density-based Removal of Bacteria from Cafeteria roenbergensis Culture
author: Sarah Duponchel
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qiiduce

steps.title: Determine cell density
steps.instruction: Stain 10 µL of Cafeteria roenbergensis culture with 1 µL Lugol’s acid iodine solution, mix, and count cells on a Neubauer haemocytometer.

steps.title: Pellet cells by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Transfer culture to 50 mL Falcon‑type tubes (if available) and centrifuge at 4,500 g, 20 °C for 5 min.

steps.title: Resuspend cell pellet
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 900 µL 1X Gradient Buffer (0.5 M NaCl, 1× PBS) and pipette repeatedly to disperse aggregates.

steps.title: Dilute and grow culture
steps.instruction: Adjust cell concentration to 5 × 10⁵ cells mL⁻¹ using f/2 medium supplemented with 0.03 % yeast extract; incubate overnight (≈12–16 h) at 20–25 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 10 % OptiPrep layer
steps.instruction: Dilute OptiPrep stock in 1X Gradient Buffer to 10 % (v/v) and load approximately 4 mL into the tube using a syringe with a flat‑needle, forming the top layer.

steps.title: Add 20 % OptiPrep layer
steps.instruction: Dilute OptiPrep stock in 1X Gradient Buffer to 20 % (v/v) and carefully load about 4 mL beneath the 10 % layer with a syringe and flat‑needle.

steps.title: Load cell suspension
steps.instruction: In SW40 Ultra‑Clear centrifuge tubes, add the cell suspension (max 5 mL) prepared in 1X Gradient Buffer, ensuring total volume does not exceed 5 mL.

steps.title: Ultracentrifuge gradient
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes at 20,000 rpm, 20 °C for 20 min with slow braking.

steps.title: Collect cells from interphase
steps.instruction: Recover the flagellate cells from the interphase between the 10 % and 20 % OptiPrep layers by pipetting from the top or using a syringe and needle.

steps.title: Microscopic assessment
steps.instruction: Dilute the recovered sample in at least 10 mL fresh f/2 medium, then examine under a light microscope to assess bacterial contamination and flagellate density; if needed, test alternative OptiPrep gradients (30 %–10 %).

steps.title: Remove residual OptiPrep
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the collected flagellates at 4,500 g for 5 min at room temperature to pellet cells and discard the supernatant containing OptiPrep.
